text:
deploy-bot: initiating rollout release-3.3.0 -> canary (8%) eu-west1 at 7212345678. Monitoring p95, error-rate, kv-cache, and queue-depth. autopilot=notify (no auto-revert).
rafael: noticed spike in embeddings p95 at ~7212345682; hosts 7/9 affected. dash: https://internal.metrics/redwood/3.3.0/embeds
jenn: query: `max_over_time(embeds_p95_ms[2m]) by (host)` -> three hosts ~300ms vs baseline ~95ms.
tim-oncall: autopilot off -> manual decision. options: (A) targeted pin for embeddings route, (B) pause entire canary, (C) apply feature-flag to reduce kv_cache limit and continue. Pros/cons?
rafael: prefer A + C: pin embeddings to last-stable 3.2.7 for customer stability, simultaneously open FF to reduce kv cache to 0.8 of default to test memory hypothesis.
jen n: +1. avoids broad customer impact. we'll need release notes update and account notify for any dedicated/customers.
ops-bot: opened task RED-7718 "3.3.0 embeds latency - targeted pin and kvcache flag" and alerted #customer-success.
support-bot: drafted customer note: "We're pausing the embeddings update for some traffic while we investigate a latency regression; no data loss expected." ready for review.
tim-oncall: who executes? rafael to run traffic-slice, jenn to pin version, ops to open FF PR and monitor. legal/AMs cc if any SLA risk.
rafael: running: `redwoodctl rollout traffic-set --release=release-3.3.0 --route=embeddings --canary=0 --target=3.2.7`
jenn: pinning: `redwoodctl versions pin --route=embeddings --version=3.2.7 --reason "p95 regression on 3.3.0 canary"`
rafael: traffic-set completed at 7212345689. embeddings canary -> 0%.
jenn: pin success at 7212345690.
ops-bot: feature-flag PR created: `kvcache.reduce_ratio=0.8` link: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/5678. will roll via FF to canary hosts once reviewed.
rafael: metrics stabilizing on pinned slice; p95 back to ~100ms at 7212345692.
support-bot: customer messages queued at 7212345693; account teams notified.
tim-oncall: changing state -> "embeds-targeted-pinned" and scheduling change-window note: rollback executed outside change-window due to regression; will record in release tracker and notify PM. Who owns RCA? jenn infra lead for heap/kvcache, rafael owns customer timeline and release notes.
jenn: taking RCA. I'll gather heapdumps and kernel logs, and check quantization path.
rafael: updating release notes: added entry "Embeddings route temporarily pinned to 3.2.7 due to p95 regression observed in canary of 3.3.0; investigating kvcache pressure and kernel-path differences."
tim-oncall: final status: targeted rollback done, canary paused for embeddings, FF PR open for kvcache trial. Support & customers notified. RCA ETA 48 hours. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: recorded events: traffic_set=7212345689 pin=7212345690 customer-notify=7212345693 state_change=7212345694.
rafael: thanks team. I'll link findings to RED-7718 once available.
